meta.name: google-ads-copy
meta.description: Generate and A/B test Google Ads copy. Use when asked to write ad copy, headlines, descriptions, create ad variants, test ad messaging, improve CTR, or generate RSA (Responsive Search Ad) components. Trigger on "ad copy", "write ads", "headlines", "descriptions", "RSA", "responsive search ad", "ad text", "ad creative", "improve CTR", "ad A/B test", "ad variants", "write me an ad", "ad variation experiment", or when the user wants to improve click-through rate on existing ads.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成并A/B测试谷歌广告文案，提升点击率
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速创建和优化谷歌搜索广告文案。
copy.tagline_en: Generate and A/B test Google Ads copy to boost CTR.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create and optimize Google Search ad copy.

howto.what: Claude 会按你的广告组和关键词撰写 Google Ads 自适应搜索广告(RSA)的标题和描述,并按转化数据规划 A/B 测试;部署前会先让你确认,改动 7 天可撤销。它遵守字符上限,不写未经证实的“best/#1”,不点名竞争对手。
howto.when: 当你说“写广告”“生成标题/描述”“做广告 A/B 测试”等,或想提高现有广告的点击率时触发。

say.text: 为“搬家服务”广告组写 5 个标题和 2 条描述。
say.note: 生成符合 RSA 字数限制的文案。

say.text: 现有广告点击率低,做一个信任感与价格对比的 A/B 测试。
say.note: 它会规划两个变体并设置实验。

say.text: 给这组广告生成 3 个不同卖点的变体,别只换词。

howto.what_en: Claude writes RSA headlines/descriptions for your ad groups, plans A/B tests against conversion data, confirms before deploying, and changes are undoable for 7 days. Enforces character limits, no unverified 'best'/'#1', no competitor names.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to write ad copy, generate headlines/descriptions, run ad A/B tests, or improve CTR on existing ads.

say_en.text: Write 5 headlines and 2 descriptions for the 'moving services' ad group.
say_en.note: Generates RSA assets within character limits.

say_en.text: Existing ads have low CTR; set up an A/B test comparing trust vs. price angles.
say_en.note: It plans two variants and sets up the experiment.

say_en.text: Create 3 variants with different angles for this ad group, not word swaps.
